HowItWorks.title: How to read a record
HowItWorks.intro: Each project carries a domain code and a number inside that domain — AI · 014 is entry 14 in artificial intelligence. Open a record for its location on the map, the team it needs, how hard it is to rebuild, and what to fix to make it ten times better.

unitTaglines.cde: Spreads entrepreneurial thinking and trains students who hold projects and ideas.
unitTaglines.business-incubator: Physical and technical space that turns an idea into a marketable business.
unitTaglines.cati: Guides researchers and students through intellectual property and patents.
unitTaglines.blue-bleu: Builds strategic partnerships between the university and local industry.
unitTaglines.mia: A space for AI research and technology, and for its digital applications.
unitTaglines.student-services: Psychological support, digital services and teaching portals for campus life.

unitDescriptions.cde: The centre spreads entrepreneurial thinking across the student body, then supports and trains students who hold a project or an idea so that it becomes a startup or a micro-enterprise.
unitDescriptions.business-incubator: The incubator gives innovative projects a physical and technical space. It helps founders develop their business model and guides them until the product is ready for the market.
unitDescriptions.cati: CATI supports researchers and students on intellectual property: patent searches, filings and the protection of the intellectual property rights attached to inventions and research.
unitDescriptions.blue-bleu: The liaison office builds strategic partnerships between the university and the economic and industrial enterprises around it. It opens student internships and steers research topics towards the needs of companies and the market.
unitDescriptions.mia: The AI House is dedicated to research and technology in artificial intelligence, and to encouraging digital applications built on it across the university.
unitDescriptions.student-services: Psychological support centres, digital services and teaching portals that make campus life easier and carry the university’s administrative and pedagogical services online.

Policy.title: Terms & Privacy
Policy.intro: This page explains how this directory works, how your data is handled, and the terms that apply when you browse or contribute.

usage.title: 1. Purpose & use
usage.body: The service is an open, trilingual directory of deep-tech initiatives. It is provided for information purposes: browsing is free and does not require an account.

accounts.title: 2. Accounts & contributions
accounts.body: Submitting or saving content may require an account. Account data is limited to what is necessary to provide these features, and credentials are protected with industry-standard measures.

content.title: 3. Content & accuracy
content.body: Initiative entries are compiled and reviewed by editors. We make reasonable efforts to keep information current, but we do not guarantee completeness or accuracy. Company details, funding and contact information may change over time.

ip.title: 4. Intellectual property
ip.body: Content you submit remains yours. By submitting it you grant us a non-exclusive licence to display and maintain it in the directory. Logos and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

privacy.title: 5. Privacy
privacy.body: We collect only what is needed to run the service: account details you provide, items you save to your account, and anonymous usage data on the pages you visit. This data is never sold to third parties.

cookies.title: 6. Cookies
cookies.body: We use a small number of cookies for core functions: language preference, visual theme, and session persistence when signed in. No advertising or cross-site tracking cookies are used.

liability.title: 7. Liability
liability.body: The service is provided “as is”, without warranty of any kind. We are not liable for how the directory is used or for decisions made on the basis of its content.

contact.title: 8. Contact & credits
contact.body: For any question about these terms or about your data, contact the team that maintains this directory.
contact.credit: Built by T. Chams at the Tebessa Incubator.
